text:
Which property explains why methane is used as a fuel?
A
It is an alkane.
B
It forms carbon dioxide when it burns.
C
It is a gas at room temperature.
D
It releases heat energy when it burns.

options.label: B
options.text: It forms carbon dioxide when it burns.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a gas at room temperature.

options.label: D
options.text: It releases heat energy when it burns.
